description: A festive holiday shelf or console vignette with a warm dark walnut wood surface. The scene is styled for Christmas with a collection of seasonal decorative objects. Camera is at seated eye-level using a normal to telephoto lens, vignette composition focused on the shelf surface. Camera pitch is level.
